summary: All eight checks pass. The three retained failures are resolved. Package unchanged; no publishing or database writes.

source_analysis.skill: Identify true triangularity statements by testing strict off-diagonal regions after the indicated matrix transformation.
reasoning_steps: Compute the indicated transpose, sum or difference.
Check the required region for zeros.
invariants: Upper triangular requires zeros below the diagonal; lower requires zeros above.
Diagonal entries do not determine triangularity.
Preserve observed operations, checkbox responses and comparable workload.
permitted_variations: Vary entries, labels and nonzero positions.
Vary which off-diagonal regions contain nonzeros.
Vary mirrored cancellation in hard questions.

source_replay.details: All 12 supplied source questions replay with complete banks. Retained regressions fail on old code and pass on the revision.

math.details: Independent exact arithmetic verified 106 records, including keys, proof matrices, truth assertions and witnesses.

variety.details: Every moderate bank supports all four zero-region cases; hard banks also vary cancellation. Valid boundaries pass and malformed inputs reject.

scope.details: Observed dimensions, operations and workload are preserved. The canonical example’s missing answer bank is documented.

grading.details: The native grader matched 280 accepted and 280 rejected Boolean submissions.

rendering.details: Ten records rendered through the actual UI. Runner and counterfactual screenshots were visually inspected.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions, relocation, deterministic generation and runner replay pass. Package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: The prior shortcut is broken within every controlled family and solves only 3/5 delivered runner items. Counterfactuals pass math, grading and rendering checks. The batch covers two response patterns; live-selection and inventory-provenance limits are explicit.
